newsitem.title: INDIA: India SBI to open branch in Johannesburg.
newsitem.headline: India SBI to open branch in Johannesburg.

text.p: India's largest commercial bank State Bank of India (SBI) said on Friday it will open a branch in the South African capital of Johannesburg on March 1.
This will be SBI's 52nd overseas office and the fifth in Africa, the bank said in a statement.
"India-related trade transactions will be the main focus for the business of the branch," the statement said.

"South Africa's growing commercial links with the U.K, U.S., Japan, Germany and Mauritius, in all of which State Bank already has its offices, will constitute a potential source of business," it added.
The branch will also raise resources and deploy funds in foreign currency, it said.
